Notes.Name: Combine an array into a string with semicolon separator
Notes.Details: Uses a join to combine the strings

Notes.Name: Combine an array into a string with space separator
Notes.Details: Uses a join to combine the strings

Notes.Name: Composite Format String
Notes.Snippet:
$string = 'The quick brown {0} jumps over the lazy {1}.'
$string -f 'fox','dog'
Notes.Details: Allows for the easy replacement of certain characters. Great when dealing with multiple languages.

Notes.Name: Use StringBuilder to combine multiple strings
Notes.Details: This performs much better the stanard array builder of +=

Notes.Name: Combine multiple strings
Notes.Snippet:
$string1 = "The quick brown fox "
$string2 ="jumps over the lazy dog"
$string1 + $string2
Notes.Details:
This should only be used for a fixed number of strings.
For combining a lot of strings or an unknown number, refer to the StringBuilder
